subject: 英语
topic: Unit 5 There is a big bed
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】clock 时钟; plant 植物; bottle 瓶子; bike 自行车; photo 照片; beside 在……旁边; between 在……之间; above 在……上方; behind 在……后面; in front of 在……前面
【重点句型】There is ... 有……（单数） There are ... 有……（复数） Where is ...? ……在哪里？ It's ... the ... 它在……的…… The ... is/are ... 那个……是……
【A Let's talk】Zhang Peng: Your room is really nice! Mike: Thanks. Zhang Peng: There is a big bed. Mike: Yes. There is a computer, too. Zhang Peng: There are so many pictures!
【Read and write】This is my room. There is a big bed, a desk and a chair. There is a clock above the bed. There is a plant beside the window. There is a bike behind the door. There are many photos on the wall.
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
